mechanism: Metoclopramide enhances gastric motility and accelerates gastric emptying, which may increase gentamicin absorption and peak serum levels, while gentamicin is nephrotoxic and metoclopramide may mask gastrointestinal symptoms of toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels; assess for ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity symptoms.
